product.name: Wage Advance
product.description: Allows employees to access up to $2,000 of their earned wages before payday, repaid on the next payday with a 5% fee and interest.

product.name: Bill Split
product.description: Allows users to pay bills up to $600 upfront and repay in 3 or 4 installments aligned with their paydays, with a 5% fee and no interest.
